lines.shooter.radio.sighted: Fortress sighted over the valley. Weapons free!
lines.shooter.radio.fortress: A flying fortress! Shoot off its gun pods first!
lines.shooter.radio.cruiser: A cruiser! Hit it while it turns!
lines.shooter.radio.caverns: Into the caverns! Grab the capsules and power up!
lines.shooter.stage1.name: EMERALD VALLEY
lines.shooter.stage2.name: CRYSTAL CAVERNS
lines.shooter.stage2.touch: DRAG to fly, POWER takes the lit slot

notes.shooter.name.eagle: The player's call sign on the radio (the pilot of the player's plane): shown as the speaker's name over a radio call.
notes.shooter.name.hq: Headquarters, the commander who calls the player on the radio: the speaker's name over the call.
notes.shooter.radio.sighted: The pilot, on the radio, as the first stage starts.
notes.shooter.radio.hit: The pilot, on the radio, when the player's plane is shot down.
notes.shooter.radio.down: The pilot, on the radio, when the first stage's boss (a flying fortress) falls.
notes.shooter.radio.fortress: HQ to the pilot as the boss appears: its gun pods are the guns on its wings.
notes.shooter.radio.cruiser: The pilot, as the second stage's mid-boss (a flying cruiser that loops) appears.
notes.shooter.radio.caverns: The pilot, as the second stage starts: capsules are pick-ups that light the power bar.
notes.shooter.radio.core: The pilot, when the last boss's core is destroyed: the end of the game.
notes.shooter.hud.pow: Power: the weapon's level (chevrons follow it).
notes.shooter.hud.max: The weapon at its highest power (in place of POW).
notes.shooter.stage1.keys: The stage card's key help: {key:fire} shoots, {key:bomb} drops a bomb (the keys or buttons). Two hints five spaces apart.
notes.shooter.stage1.touch: The same on a touch screen: a finger dragged anywhere flies the plane, which fires by itself; {key:bomb} is the bomb button.
notes.shooter.clear.score: {score} is the score, seven digits with leading zeros.
notes.shooter.table: The title of the shooter's high-score table.
notes.shooter.stage2.keys: Stage 2's key help: {key:fire} shoots, {key:bomb} takes the power lit on the power bar.
notes.shooter.stage2.touch: Stage 2 on a touch screen: dragging flies, the POWER button takes the lit slot of the power bar.
notes.shooter.touch.power: The touch button that takes the lit power (stage 2): one short word in capitals.
notes.shooter.hud.speed: SPD: the ship's speed level, {speed} 1 to 5.
notes.shooter.hud.speed_options: The speed level and OPT, the number of options (drones that follow the ship and fire with it).
notes.shooter.power.speed: The power bar's slots (Gradius): each lit in turn by capsules and taken with the bomb key. Speed: the ship faster.
notes.shooter.power.missile: A power: missiles that drop and slide along the rock.
notes.shooter.power.double: A power: a second shot fired up at an angle.
notes.shooter.power.laser: A power: a laser beam in place of the shot.
notes.shooter.power.option: A power: an option, a drone that follows the ship's path and fires as it does.
notes.shooter.power.shield: A power: a shield in front of the ship.
notes.shooter.hud.cruiser: Over the mid-boss's health bar (a flying cruiser).
notes.shooter.hud.core: Over the last boss's health bar (the core of a battleship).

brief: The shooter: an arcade shoot-'em-up in two stages, a vertical one over farmland (Emerald Valley) and a horizontal one through crystal caves (Crystal Caverns). Its screen words are short arcade capitals on a small screen; the radio calls are short, urgent, military-radio sentences between the player's pilot (call sign EAGLE 1; the player, man or woman unstated) and HQ (a gruff commander). The place names are descriptive and may be translated. The power bar's words (SPEED, MISSILE...) come from Gradius.
